3. REDUCING RISK OF VTE

•LMWH reduces Risk of VTE 60% in medical and 70% surgical pts.

 

•Recurrence:
-incidence 1.3/10,000
-1.4 – 11% recurrence within 2 weeks of initial thrombosis.
-in pregnancy 1 – 2/1000
-Relative risk in pregnancy = 4 – 6-fold,
-In pregnancy 20 – 50% VTE due to hereditary thrombophilia.
-Heritable thrombophilia are responsible for 20 – 50% of pregnancy related VTE.

•Early pregnancy/ pre – pregnancy.
•Hospital admission.
•I/P, P/P.

•FH of VTE: age < 50 years.

-APL = antiphospholipid antibodies (lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin antibodies, ẞ, -glycoprotein 1 antibodies).

-LMWH = low-molecular-weight heparin.
-long-distance travel = > 4 hours.
-low-risk thrombophilia = heterozygous for factor V Leiden or prothrombin G20210A mutations.
-OHSS = ovarian hyper stimulation syndrome.
-PGP - pelvic girdle pain with reduced mobility:
- PPH = postpartum hemorrhage.
-thrombophilia = inherited or acquired.
-VTE = venous thromboembolism.

C/I of LMWH:

•Known Bleeding disorder.
•Active A/N or P/P bleeding.
•Major Hge (previous).
•Plt < 75 x 109.
•Acute stroke in previous 4 weeks.

(both ischemic & Haemorrhagic).

•Severe Renal disease GFR < 30.
•Severe liver disease
•Uncontrolled HTN > 200/120.

UFH:

Indications:

•In women @ very high risk of Thrombosis.
•In peripartum period where ed risk of Hge or where Anaesthesia is required.
•Plt monitoring every 2 – 3 days from 4 – 14day of treatment until heparin is stopped.
•Modifiable.
•Complete reversal with protamine sulfate.
•Stop 4 hours before regional Anaesthesia.
•Less neuraxial hematoma.

Fondaparinux, Danaparoid:

•Given to women Intolerant to heparin.
•T ½ -= 24 hours avoid regional anaesthesia
•used in conjunction with haematologist.

Warfarin:

⇨Indications
•Mechanical heart valve.
•switch to LMWH 2 weeks after missed period (6 – 12 weeks).
•Stop @ 36 weeks.
•Restart after 5 – 7 days of delivery.

Dextran:

•Avoid in pregnancy.
•Anaphylactic reactions.

Oral Thrombin & x – a inhibitors.

•NOACS: Non vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulants.
•Avoided in pregnancy and breast feeding
-Dabigatran, rivaroxaban, apixaban.

Anti – embolism Stockings:

•14 – 15 mmHg in pregnancy/ puerperium in hospital where LMWH is C/I.
•Most VTE in pregnancy are iliofemoral.
•Post C/S combined with LMWH.
•Long distance travel > 4hours.

Graduated compression Stockings:

•Post embolism/ post thrombotic syndrome.
